{{Quote|All right, everything on the table. Fall in! Let's go! Quit your moving about! Last call on ordnance, if you've got a weapon and it's not on that table, it means you're either too stupid to follow orders or you're a threat to base security.|Sergeant to a group of fresh recruits|<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />}}
A '''sergeant''' with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that oversaw intake of new recruits at the [[Great Temple|rebel base]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[2 BBY]]. As part of the process the [[sergeant]] would have the new recruits place all their weapons on a table to be checked out by [[Vel Sartha]]. If a recruit did not place a weapon on the table the sergeant considered them to have failied to follow orders or be a threat to the base's security.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sergeant appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Nathan Clough]] in the episode and credited as simply "Intake sergeant".<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
